svg.title: Singular value decomposition: rotate, stretch, rotate
svg.desc: A unit circle is first rotated in input coordinates by V transpose, then stretched by diagonal Sigma with singular values 1.8 and 0.7, then rotated again by U. Circular form is unchanged by initial rotation; the ellipse axes come from scaling.
svg.text: Singular value decomposition: rotate, stretch, rotate
A = U Σ Vᵀ • Orthogonal steps preserve length; Σ sets axis scales.
